svg.title: Which words the conv+gru network mixes up (test set)
svg.desc: A 35 by 35 confusion matrix with a strong diagonal, and a bar chart of the twelve most frequent confusions, such as tree heard as three and follow heard as four.
svg.text: Which words the conv+gru network mixes up (test set)
ROWS: THE WORD SAID; COLUMNS: THE WORD HEARD, BY ITS NUMBER; SQUARE-ROOT SHADING
THE TWELVE MOST FREQUENT MISTAKES: SAID → HEARD
